title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30361: add OnAutoArchiveJobOnCaseElse event to Job Archive Management
summary: A new integration event OnAutoArchiveJobOnCaseElse is added to Job Archive Management so extensions can handle custom archive modes beyond the standard options.
key_points: Event fires in the else branch of the archive jobs case when a non-standard archive mode is set
Extensions receive the Job and Jobs Setup records as parameters
Allows custom archive handling logic to be plugged in without modifying core code
Addresses gap where unhandled archive modes silently did nothing
